name: acchan
label: Acchan
tagline: Local Jan helper for files, apps and tabs

manifest.summary: One agent on Jan's small local models (0.8B chat, 2B actions, 4B vision and code, 9B hard tasks) with about 60 tools: files and code, shell, apps, windows and keystrokes (Hyprland or GNOME), Firefox and Forge Browser tabs, terminal tabs, any player through MPRIS (Qobuz included), video transcripts and frames, whole-document questions over PDFs and web pages, the screen through OCR and vision. Plain commands run instantly without a model. Also serves an OpenAI-compatible API that Nyarch Assistant uses as its model, an MCP server for Claude Code, and a terminal client (`acchan`). Claude and Study Companion appear as tabs.

features.name: Fast path
features.description: Plain commands (open X, pause, next song, volume 40, close this window, switch to firefox) run directly in milliseconds, no model.

features.name: Model ladder
features.description: One model per chat (the 0.8B by default, tools on), stepping up a size only after two failures and staying there. 'Switch per message' keeps the old ladder. Per-tier model choice in the Jan settings.

features.name: Tools
features.description: Declared once in acchan/tools/*.py and shared by the agent, the MCP server and the prompts.

features.name: Nyarch
features.description: Point Nyarch's OpenAI provider at http://127.0.0.1:8451/v1 with model 'acchan' and it gains every tool.

features.name: Tabs
features.description: Claude (Claude Code panel) and Study Companion embedded as tabs; they keep their own backends and sidebar entries.

manifest.data_dir: ~/.local/share/forge/acchan (conversations); ~/.cache/acchan (document and transcript text cache, eval results); ~/.config/forge/jan/acchan.json (model per tier)
